title: Piercing Frame Solo #136 (일반 가슴 컷 · P50 정의형 · 스페이스번 · 발레아쥬 · 메이크업 홍콩풍 · 금속 로즈골드 · 공예 혼합 3종(Japanese Kutani porcelain+Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye+Turkish İznik tile) · 대각 띠 · 체형 매우 큰 가슴·둥근 어깨)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head to just below her chest, the frame cutting off beneath the chest. Her face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman — fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick rose-gold septum ring with a smaller rose-gold ring above it and two rose-gold rings through each nostril; a straight rose-gold bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick rose-gold bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a rose-gold Medusa stud above the lips; a big rose-gold hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a rose-gold labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small rose-gold studs along each jaw; a curved row of small rose-gold studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized rose-gold hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine rose-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a very large, heavy bust with soft rounded shoulders.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in 3 different traditional patterns, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the patterns reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her body below the collarbones is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 47% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with overglaze florals filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, with spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. The patterns of every region continue in full strength over her chest, shoulders and arms, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
